source: Own measurement, 2026-11-26, on the fixed hidden set (tests/hidden/episodes.json: 12 episodes, one per unit, draw 4 of tests/hidden/episode_selection.json) with this build's grader: at the selection the privileged reference (solution/solve.sh, token truth) scored credit 1.0 on every kept episode in three runs over the real wire (863-1056 steps in the set; its own time about 1.5 s an episode of the 9000 s budget). The `ale validate` runs of this build through the pinned engine (vendor/ale bfb7505) are named in the pull request: oracle reward 1.0 and untouched 0.0.
note: Measured, not drawn. The set holds only episodes on which the reference scored credit 1.0 in three runs over the real wire when it was selected (tests/hidden/episode_selection.json draw 4: 28 candidates tried, 20 kept, the first kept per unit; draw 1 was voided when the O-ring's tolerance changed, draw 2 when the parts were laid loose and the elbows stood up, draw 3 when the cameras' renderer, the camera rig's contact boxes and the probe copy's wrench changed). full_at 0.98: the runs showed no spread; one joint missing in one episode (0.2 of one episode, 0.017 of the metric) still leaves the reference at reward 1.0 after the engine's rounding.
